svg.title: How each controller connects and what to map it as
svg.desc: 8BitDo SNES-style: USB-C in X-input mode, Bluetooth in D-input mode, or the USB receiver on 2.4G models; map it as Super Nintendo. Retro Fighters Tribute64: 2.4 GHz receiver or USB-C, in PC mode; map it as Nintendo 64 with the C-buttons on the right stick. DualShock 4: Bluetooth (hold Share + PS) or a micro-USB data cable; map it as Default, which uses a PlayStation layout. GameCube-style pad for Switch: Bluetooth (sync button), USB, or an adapter in PC mode; map it as GameCube or Default. Also map Kodi Default on every pad for the menus. Lowest lag: USB cable or 2.4 GHz receiver; Bluetooth is fine for most games.

g.text: USB, or adapter in PC mode
